scope: One supported invocation, one PID namespace and unchanged boot; serial original Popen handles, no retries, no extraction, installation, model loading or model calls. No existing packet or source edits. The completed work relocation is verified, never repeated.
clock_accounting: Each unchanged driver captures and retains its original phase endpoint; no child can borrow another phase's allowance. The coordinator credits only elapsed phase/review time up to that phase's fixed ceiling. All remaining startup, launch, checks and fallback time belongs to the separate 60-second coordinator allowance. The absolute envelope is never reset. Review may finish early after exact approval; it expires after 600 seconds.
loader_observations: Finite observations before each of the four child stages and at coordinator terminal: LD_PRELOAD, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, LD_AUDIT and GLIBC_TUNABLES must be absent from the environment, including present-but-empty; lstat must report /etc/ld.so.preload absent, so a dangling symlink also refuses. No environment values are recorded. This is not continuous or per-artifact loader verification.

resources.output_charged_category: source; existing child accounting also retains the separate evidence category
resources.fresh_download_admission: The unchanged driver and downloader retain their existing fresh dynamic admission, disk reservation, limits and 10800-second original budget.

output_rules: Exclusive one-shot directory and exclusive files; no overwrites or evidence deletion. Only the owner may prepare approval.pending and rename it to previously absent approval.json after writing and fsync. The helper consumes that exact record once by rename to approval.consumed.json. STOP is an optional owner-created stop request. All file names above and the output directory allocation count toward the inclusive 1 MiB ceiling. No other output files are allowed.
review_gates: Both original fixture driver handles must be positively waited with exit 0. Each final outer guard must report PASS, CONFIRMED cleanup, original child wait, exit 0, verified final source pins and empty errors/unresolved/direct children. Raw fixture results must show exactly 24 and 37 tests, zero failures, errors, skips, network requests and model calls/loads; both nested guard fixture original waits must match success0 and nonzero1. The marker binds both guards and raw results, original handles, boot/namespace, config, packet, product verification and immutable source pins. The entire review pause must have zero children. Changed pins, expiry, refusal, STOP or uncertain cleanup makes download impossible.
approval_authority: The owner writes the record only after the named independent reviewer approves this exact marker. This is an owner-controlled filesystem handoff, not a cryptographic assertion about another same-UID writer.
termination: No active child is replaced. The original guard gets its complete unchanged work and cleanup endpoint before bounded pidfd-only fallback against that retained original handle. SIGTERM then SIGKILL fallback remains inside the coordinator allowance and absolute endpoint. Every original handle must be positively waited; any unconfirmed descendant cleanup or missing wait is terminal UNKNOWN with preserved evidence and no further phase. No numeric-PID or process-group signaling.
historical_status: The preserved initial config's original guard invocation refused before dispatch with exit 2; it is not a fixture pass. The earlier interrupted acquisition remains historically unresolved.
